nodes.label: edge-tts OGG/Opus Voice Notes
nodes.rationale: First sentence synthesized alone and sent at once, rest in parallel, because speech synthesis dominates latency.

nodes.label: Groq Model Pool Rotation
nodes.rationale: Each model has ~8000 tokens/minute on free tier, so rotate to the next when one runs out.

nodes.label: Spoken Daily Check-in (24h window)
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp forbids business-initiated audio and free-form messages outside the 24-hour customer service window; words come only from .state/briefing.json so the voice cannot invent projects.

nodes.label: Agentic Second Brain
nodes.rationale: Resource-frugal personal assistant that resurfaces cold projects; built for an 8 GB Windows laptop with no local LLM.

nodes.label: Division of Labour: Agent Says, Code Sends
nodes.norm_label: division of labour: agent says, code sends
nodes.rationale: A confused or manipulated agent can at worst word a reminder badly; it can never send twice, spam, or write to a project.

nodes.label: n8n Service (sb-n8n)
nodes.rationale: Single service after Telegram replaced Evolution/Postgres/Redis; SQLite backend, 450m mem_limit, task runners disabled to avoid OOM from a second Node process.

nodes.label: Read-only Vault Mount (/data/vault)
nodes.rationale: Read-only so a buggy or compromised workflow can never rewrite or delete the knowledge base.

nodes.label: n8n Owner Account + N8N_SECURE_COOKIE=false
nodes.rationale: Modern n8n removed basic auth; secure cookie relaxed because browsers refuse Secure cookies over plain http://localhost, safe because bound to loopback.

nodes.label: .wslconfig WSL2 RAM Cap
nodes.rationale: Caps Docker globally at 2 GB so Windows keeps ~6 GB.

nodes.label: Morning Nudge Pipeline (n8n, 08:00 cron)
nodes.rationale: Zero-noise mornings: if nothing is stale the filter returns [] and nothing is sent.

nodes.label: Node 2 - Scan & Read Vault (Code, fs)
nodes.rationale: Reads with Node fs rather than binary Read Files node: deterministic, version-stable, less memory.

nodes.label: test-pipeline.mjs Regression Test
nodes.rationale: Runs the exact JS embedded in workflow JSON against time-relative fixtures; no Docker or keys needed.

nodes.label: Legacy n8n + Docker Stack
nodes.rationale: Kept for reference only: read only hand-written vault notes, needed ~1 GB RAM for Docker, Evolution API WhatsApp gateway could not link new devices, and the Groq model llama-3.3-70b-versatile was retired.

nodes.label: Memory Budget (450 MB hard ceiling)
nodes.rationale: Levers: one service, SQLite not Postgres, V8 heap capped below container limit for clean GC, execution pruning.

nodes.label: Flat YAML Frontmatter Schema
nodes.rationale: Flat scalars only so a tiny regex parser can read metadata at ~0 RAM; type is the discriminator.

nodes.label: last_actionable_date Heartbeat
nodes.rationale: The single field staleness is computed against; stale_after_days gives per-note override.

nodes.label: Node 3 - Filter Stale Projects (Code)
nodes.rationale: Regex frontmatter parse, applies action log, local-midnight days_stale, ranks deadline > priority > days_stale, trims notes to 8 signal lines to cut token cost.

nodes.label: No Local Vector DB Decision
nodes.rationale: Small vault makes linear scan milliseconds; Chroma/Qdrant would add 300-800 MB always-on RAM; semantic recall offloaded to cloud LLM.

nodes.label: Pre-sorted Single-Target Selection
nodes.rationale: Ranking done in code before the call so output is deterministic and a cheap/fast model does well.

nodes.label: Writable Inbox Mount (/data/inbox)
nodes.rationale: Separate writable path for captures and the action log so capture flows cannot corrupt notes.

nodes.label: Action Log (.actions.jsonl)
nodes.rationale: Shared contract between commands and the morning filter: latest matching touch/done/reopen wins; read skipped silently if inbox not mounted.

nodes.label: getUpdates Long Polling (timeout < interval)
nodes.rationale: n8n is loopback-only with no public URL, so polling avoids a tunnel; poll hold (4s) < cadence (5s) prevents overlapping consumers and HTTP 409.

nodes.label: Offset File (.tg_offset)
nodes.rationale: File not n8n static data, because static data is not persisted on manual runs; advanced early, before the slow LLM call, so nothing is handled twice.

nodes.label: Short-term Memory (.tg_history.json)
nodes.rationale: Bounded to 8 turns and self-resetting on new nudge or 6-hour gap so token budget cannot balloon and yesterday's chat never leaks.

nodes.label: Check-in Guards (4h window, first-reply-only)
nodes.rationale: No second poller to avoid getUpdates 409 clash; graceful no-match logs nothing rather than a spurious touch.

nodes.label: Evening Check-in Workflow (20:30 cron)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the staleness clock honest without remembering slash commands; plain-language reply mapped by LLM into touch actions.

nodes.label: Proven vs Trusted-but-not-executed
nodes.rationale: 87 assertions prove logic offline; residual risk is n8n node schemas, image tag pulls, and live API 200s which need a real machine.

nodes.label: $env-exposed Secrets (GROQ_API_KEY, TELEGRAM_*)
nodes.rationale: N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false lets workflow expressions read keys directly; safe because single-user loopback-only instance.

nodes.label: Node 4 - Cloud LLM Synthesis (Groq)
nodes.rationale: Env-driven model (GROQ_MODEL) so a retired model id can be swapped without editing the workflow; Retry On Fail for 429s.

nodes.label: Node 4b - Extract Nudge (Code)
nodes.rationale: Normalizes Groq and Gemini shapes, strips fences, throws on empty completion so error handler alerts, escapes then renders *bold*/_italic_ to Telegram HTML.

nodes.label: Anti-hallucination Guardrail
nodes.rationale: Model may only paraphrase recent_notes; empty notes trigger a re-read-the-note fallback.

nodes.label: HOOK / CONTEXT / MICRO-ACTION Flow
nodes.rationale: Loss-aversion hook, frictionless re-entry context, and a <=10-minute action to defeat activation energy.

nodes.label: .env Changes Require Recreate
nodes.rationale: Env vars are baked in at container create time; docker compose restart does not pick them up.

nodes.label: Error -> Telegram Alert Workflow
nodes.rationale: Convenience, not system of record: if Telegram itself is down the alert also fails, but n8n Executions keep the error.

nodes.label: SYSTEM_PROMPT (chief-of-staff nudge prompt)
nodes.rationale: Stored inside a JS template literal, so no backticks or ${...}; must be edited in sync with the Code node.

nodes.label: Section 7 - Commands, Action Log & Error Alerts
nodes.norm_label: section 7 - commands, action log & error alerts

nodes.label: WhatsApp Template Name Fallback
nodes.rationale: Meta reviews every edit and allows one edit per 24h, so new wording goes under a new name while the old approved template keeps working; errors 132001/132015/132016 fall through to the next name.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Tunnel + Auto Meta Webhook Registration
nodes.norm_label: cloudflare tunnel + auto meta webhook registration
nodes.rationale: Chosen over ngrok because Avast re-signs ngrok's connection; Cloudflare runs over QUIC which Avast leaves alone.

nodes.label: Avast TLS Scanning Workaround
nodes.rationale: Avast re-signs HTTPS; tls_context() keeps cert checks but relaxes Python 3.13 strictness; Gmail port 587 because Avast breaks 465.

hyperedges.label: Telegram Staleness Loop via Shared Action Log
